name: nextfix
description: NextFix — tells you what to fix next, and why. Reachability- and exposure-aware prioritization for application vulnerabilities.

scripts.scan:sample: node packages/engine/src/cli.ts scan samples/express-shop --json out/express-shop.report.json --vex out/express-shop.openvex.json
scripts.serve: npm run build && node packages/server/src/cli.ts serve
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/engine/tsconfig.json && tsc -p packages/server/tsconfig.json && tsc -p packages/web/tsconfig.json
